description:
MCP server exposing the **Sovereign AI Blog** ([sovgrid.org](https://sovgrid.org)) — a hands-on engineering log of self-hosted AI on NVIDIA DGX Spark hardware (GB10/SM121A). 44+ and growing articles covering SGLang, Mistral, Voxtral, OpenClaw setups, fixes, and benchmarks.

**Tools:**
  - `search_blog` — full-text TF-IDF search across all articles
  - `get_article` — fetch full article content by slug
  - `diagnose_sglang` — validate SGLang configs against GB10/SM121A constraints

**Use case:** Training data on niche AI hardware is sparse and stale. This MCP gives agents direct, structured access to verified, version-current setups instead of hallucinating.

  **License:** MIT (server) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (content)
  **Auth:** none, free tier, 60 req/min/IP
  **Privacy:** server-log analytics only, no client-side tracking

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description:
Search the Sovereign AI Blog for articles matching a natural language query,
    optionally filtered by tag and sorted by relevance or date.

    Behaviour matrix:
      - query='', sort=*           -> list newest-first, optionally tag-filtered
      - query!='', sort=relevance  -> TF-IDF ranked, optionally tag-filtered
      - query!='', sort=date_desc  -> TF-IDF filtered (score > 0.001), then sorted by date

    Pure read-only, deterministic for a given KB snapshot.

n.title: N
n.description: Maximum number of results to return

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: Optional tag filter (e.g. 'setup', 'fixes', 'strategy'). Only articles with this tag are considered. Use list_tags to discover available tags.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Result ordering. 'relevance' uses TF-IDF score (default for non-empty query). 'date_desc' sorts newest first (default behaviour when query is empty). When query is empty, 'relevance' is treated as 'date_desc'.

query.title: Query
query.description: Natural language search query (e.g. 'flashinfer OOM on GB10'). Multi-word queries are tokenized and TF-IDF ranked. Pass empty string to list articles without ranking by relevance.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description:
Retrieve the full content of a blog article by its slug.

    Returns the article body (Markdown) plus metadata. If the slug does not
    match any article, returns an Article with `error='article_not_found'`
    and other fields at their defaults.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Article slug as returned by search_blog (e.g. 'setup-mistral-sglang-setup'). Lower-case, hyphenated.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Topic tags assigned to the article

error.title: Error
error.description: Set to 'article_not_found' if no article matches the slug

word_count.title: Word Count
word_count.description: Word count of the article body

quality_class.title: Quality Class
quality_class.description: Editorial content class (e.g. 'Ephemeral', 'Evergreen'). Empty if not classified.

quality_score.title: Quality Score
quality_score.description: Build-time quality score from the editorial pipeline (unbounded weighted composite across 13 signals, higher is better; thresholds depend on style)

quality_style.title: Quality Style
quality_style.description: Editorial style category (e.g. 'best_practice_learnings', 'werthaltige_code_beispiele'). Empty if not categorised.

tools.name: diagnose_sglang
tools.description:
Validate an SGLang configuration for NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10/SM121A).

    Pure pattern-matching against known failure modes documented in the
    Sovereign AI Blog. No inference, no external calls. Returns critical
    issues, non-fatal warnings, and a recommended baseline config.

    All parameters are optional; supply only what you have. With no inputs
    you get the recommended config and a 'unknown' verdict.

hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.description: Hardware description (e.g. 'GB10', 'DGX Spark', 'SM121A'). Empty = skip GB10-specific rules.

image_tag.title: Image Tag
image_tag.description: Docker image tag in use (e.g. 'lmsysorg/sglang:latest', 'lmsysorg/sglang:v0.4.0'). Empty = skip.

error_message.title: Error Message
error_message.description: Paste error log output here for pattern matching against known failure modes.

attention_backend.title: Attention Backend
attention_backend.description: SGLang --attention-backend value (e.g. 'flashinfer', 'triton'). Empty string = skip this check.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Critical issues that will prevent SGLang from running correctly

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description:
List all topic tags used across the Sovereign AI Blog corpus, with article
    counts. Use this to browse the topic space before calling search_blog with
    a tag filter.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Result ordering. 'count_desc' lists most-used tags first (default). 'alpha' sorts alphabetically.
